result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visual defects: restaurant name text appears clipped mid-character in the 'Popular right now' section, and a horizontally scrolling card title is truncated without an ellipsis. Other partially visible elements (right-edge chip, bottom pizza card) appear to be normal scroll/carousel overflow rather than defects.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramei' appears hard-clipped mid-word (likely 'Tokumaru Ramen'), with the final letter cut off and no ellipsis, making the text look broken.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis (text-overflow: ellipsis) or allow the label enough width/wrapping so the full name renders correctly.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card's title 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off at the screen edge without an ellipsis, so the name reads as broken text rather than intentionally scrollable content.
issues.suggestion: Truncate the label with an ellipsis within the card bounds, or clip the whole card cleanly so partially visible text doesn't appear malformed.

issues.description: A category filter chip at the far right of the chip row is cut off with only a sliver visible, giving little affordance that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Show a larger visible portion of the next chip (peek pattern) or add a subtle edge gradient to indicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) icon on the Tokumaru Ramen card sits directly over a dark image without a contrasting background, unlike the pizza card below where it has a dark circular backdrop, creating inconsistent icon treatment.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent semi-transparent circular background behind favorite icons on all restaurant cards to ensure visibility and visual consistency.
